resources.string: For the selected AirPods. Profile connections do not confirm the current media or call route.
Choose your AirPods before checking their connection.
Allow Nearby devices in app settings, then return here.
Turn on Bluetooth in Android settings, then check again.
The last observation is too old to confirm the current state.
No recent control data. Idle AirPods can be quiet; this does not confirm a failure.
The app could not obtain a current service response. Open diagnostics if available.
No current observation for these AirPods. Check Android Bluetooth settings.
The control socket opened, but no incoming device data has been observed yet.
Incoming data was observed on the current control connection. This does not confirm audio routing.
The foreground service responded. This does not guarantee uninterrupted background execution.
The service has not reported a successful foreground start yet.
The observed service has stopped. Reopen LibrePods and check again.
Check the Media audio switch for these AirPods in Android Bluetooth settings.
Check the Phone calls switch for these AirPods in Android Bluetooth settings. This is not active call audio.
The control channel closed. Audio may still be connected; check Bluetooth settings or diagnostics.
Android reports background restrictions. Review app battery settings if background work stops.
Battery optimization is enabled. If background work stops, review battery settings.
No restriction was reported by these Android checks. Manufacturer limits may still apply.
Android background restrictions could not be fully checked.
Audio and control observations expire after 2 minutes. Refresh rereads available state and does not reconnect.
Could not open that screen. Open the corresponding Android settings manually.
